scheduling.summary: Email hearing time requests to assistant Brittany Smith (smithb@jud14.flcourts.org) with opposing counsel CCed. Specially set hearings are 35 minutes minimum; held in person at Bay County Courthouse unless Court grants Zoom. Motion calendar dockets ~every Monday at 9:00am and 1:00pm CST for 15-minute hearings. Most motions set within 60 days of filing (30 days for simpler motions). Trial setting via email; CMC only needed for jury trials over 2 weeks or date disputes.
scheduling.key_quote: DO NOT call the judge’s office to request hearing time.

conferral.summary: Good faith certification required for most non-dispositive motions. Must attempt email plus at least two phone calls if no response. Broader than Rule 1.202. Not required for dispositive, emergency, or post-trial motions.
conferral.key_quote: This Court’s requirement of conferral is broader than that
conferral.quote_locator: henry-admin-procedures-extracted.txt, Page 6, item 1 (continues: "included in Rule 1.202, Florida Rules of Civil Procedure")

submissions.summary: Hearing materials due at least 2 business days prior via OneDrive drop box (preferred) or hard copy mail. No email or hard-copy binders unless directed. Request drop box from assistant with all counsel email addresses. Documents uploaded as separate PDFs; no zip files. All uploads complete 1 business day prior.
submissions.key_quote: DO NOT MAIL HARD COPIES OR A BINDER OF
submissions.quote_locator: henry-admin-procedures-extracted.txt, Page 12, item 2 (continues: "CASE LAW OR OTHER HEARING MATERIALS unless specifically directed by the judicial assistant")

proposed_orders.summary: Submit via e-filing portal in Word format (DJCMA, omit M&A service portions) with PDF cover letter indicating agreement status. No hidden formatting. Judge office does not mail copies of orders. Non-compliant orders will not be entered.
proposed_orders.key_quote: Any proposed order not complying with the above instructions will not be entered

courtesy_copies.summary: No separate "courtesy copy" requirement stated. Hearing materials submitted via OneDrive drop box (see submissions). Judge office does not mail copies of orders.
courtesy_copies.key_quote: The judge’s office will not mail out copies of any orders.

remote_appearance.summary: Zoom used for motion calendar dockets and any hearing where Court permits. Connection: zoom.us/j/6942431871 (Meeting ID 694 243 1871). Video required; log in 5 min early; judge admits from waiting room. Specially set hearings are in person unless Court specifically grants Zoom. Frivolous Zoom requests may be sanctioned.
remote_appearance.key_quote: will be held IN PERSON (not via Zoom)
remote_appearance.quote_locator: henry-admin-procedures-extracted.txt, Page 2, item 2 (full: "all specially set hearings (not including the Court’s Motion Calendar Docket) will be held IN PERSON (not via Zoom) at the Bay County Courthouse, unless the Court specifically grants a request to appear via Zoom")

communications.summary: All requests (hearing time, trial dates, CMC) by email to smithb@jud14.flcourts.org with opposing counsel CCed. Subject line: Bay County case number and style. Do not include assistant in inter-counsel email chains. Assistant reply-alls with available dates. Bay County is central time zone. Cancellations/settlements notified by email.
communications.key_quote: Only email the judicial assistant to request dates and confirm the hearing date.

family_law_note.summary: Judge Henry also handles family law matters (per admin procedures pp. 16-25). Basic procedures mirror civil: email assistant for hearing time, motion calendar dockets, OneDrive for materials, e-filing for proposed orders, Zoom for motion calendar. Final hearing time blocks: 15 min per motion, 1 hour for temporary relief/child pick-up/exception, half-day or all-day for final hearings.
family_law_note.note: Recorded for completeness; family law is noncivil assignment scope.
